1.thieu: May find it hard to put feelings into words; others have to guess.
1.mot: Moderate expression; sometimes hard to voice deeper things.
1.hai: Balanced expression; can speak both reason and feeling.
1.ba_tro_len: Talks a lot; may dominate, or withdraw when not heard; worth practising listening.

2.y_nghia: Intuition, sensitivity to other people's feelings.
2.thieu: May unintentionally overlook the feelings of people around you.
2.mot: Moderately sensitive; can read the room.
2.hai: Good intuition; tends to sense what others are thinking.
2.ba_tro_len: Very sensitive; easily hurt, easily swept up in other people's emotions.

3.thieu: May forget short-term tasks; taking notes helps.
3.hai: Quick thinker, full of ideas, sometimes far from reality.
3.ba_tro_len: Lives a lot inside the head; prone to overthinking.

4.y_nghia: Practicality, order, working with the hands.
4.thieu: May lack patience for detail and organising.
4.hai: Very practical, good at organising, can be rigid.
4.ba_tro_len: Heavy on material things and rules; finds it hard to be flexible.

5.thieu: May lack motivation and find it hard to show affection; worth finding what excites you.
5.hai: Lots of energy, forceful, sometimes impulsive.
5.ba_tro_len: Strong emotions, quick temper; needs an outlet for all that energy.

6.y_nghia: Creativity, responsibility for family, the home.
6.thieu: May feel little attachment to home, or not yet have found a place to belong.
6.mot: Loves family, has a creative streak.
6.hai: Cares a great deal for family; prone to worry.
6.ba_tro_len: Prone to anxiety; may control loved ones out of worry.

7.thieu: May repeat old lessons because they have not yet sunk in.
7.hai: Goes through many ups and downs and grows through them.
7.ba_tro_len: Life brings many hard lessons; worth taking good care of your inner life.

8.thieu: May lack patience for detail; needs someone to help.
8.mot: Thorough, takes responsibility for their own work.
8.hai: Refined, independent, likes to do things themselves.
8.ba_tro_len: Prone to perfectionism; uncomfortable when things do not go their way.

9.y_nghia: Ideals, ambition, responsibility to the community.
9.thieu: (Rare — anyone born in the 1900s always has a 9.) May lack outward-looking motivation.
9.mot: Has ideals, wants to do something useful.
9.hai: Clear ambition; tends to set high standards for others.
9.ba_tro_len: Very high ideals; prone to criticising, hard to satisfy.

1-2-3.y_nghia: Tends to plan and organise before acting.
1-2-3.mat_toi: May dislike surprises and feel irritated when others do not follow the plan.

4-5-6.y_nghia: Described as strong-willed: once decided, it gets done.
4-5-6.mat_toi: May be stubborn and find it hard to take advice.

7-8-9.y_nghia: Likes to get on with things, learns by doing.
7-8-9.mat_toi: May get restless when made to wait; acts first, thinks later.

3-6-9.y_nghia: Thinks well, good memory, enjoys learning.
3-6-9.mat_toi: May look down on people who are slow to understand; lives a lot inside the head.

2-5-8.y_nghia: Emotionally balanced, understands people, easily wins goodwill.

1-4-7.y_nghia: Handy, practical, good at concrete tasks.
1-4-7.mat_toi: May place too much weight on material things and shy away from the abstract.

1-5-9.y_nghia: Described as steadfast, pursuing goals to the end.
1-5-9.mat_toi: May be obstinate and ignore the signs that it is time to stop.

3-5-7.y_nghia: Perceptive, with inner depth, often searching for meaning.
3-5-7.mat_toi: May be vague and detached from reality.

1-2-3.y_nghia: Tends to act on impulse and plan little.
1-2-3.goi_y: Try planning one week and see what changes.

4-5-6.y_nghia: Easily disappointed when things do not go as hoped; frustration builds up inside.
4-5-6.goi_y: Find a healthy way to let feelings out; set smaller expectations for each step.

7-8-9.y_nghia: Tends to hesitate before starting, waiting for perfect conditions.
7-8-9.goi_y: Start with the smallest thing you can do right now in 5 minutes.

3-6-9.y_nghia: Tends to forget small tasks; needs a system for remembering.
3-6-9.goi_y: Use lists and reminders; learn with spaced repetition.

2-5-8.y_nghia: Tends to be sensitive and easily hurt, finding it hard to express feelings.
2-5-8.goi_y: Practise naming your feelings; share them with someone you trust.

1-4-7.y_nghia: Tends to feel awkward with hands-on, practical tasks.
1-4-7.goi_y: Learn one small practical skill each quarter (cooking, repairs).

1-5-9.y_nghia: Tends to procrastinate; finds it hard to start and hard to follow through.
1-5-9.goi_y: Break tasks into small pieces and set deadlines that someone else knows about.

3-5-7.y_nghia: Tends to be sceptical, needing proof before believing.
3-5-7.goi_y: Keep a healthy scepticism, but try trusting one small thing and watch what happens.

source.ten: Reference compilation (editorial draft, 2026) following the Balliett–Jordan tradition and common numerology books
source.luu_y: Draft shown by decision of the project owner (2026-09-30); a status column allows gradual review. A cultural reference, not a forecast.
